notes.title: Update 1 (Night Mode)
notes.content:
1. I added options to adjust the light intensity and temperature in the options menu, which means that you can now customize the scene lighting according to your preferences, through these two options you can set the day, dusk and night.

2. The option to adjust seat height has been added to the options menu.

3. Added shortcut options for day, dusk and night in the title interface.

4. Added car interior lights and switch buttons.

5. Fixed the road connection problem.
